settings.af.faction_blacklist.desc: List of factions to exclude (one per line). Only used when Filter Mode is 'BlacklistExclusion'.
settings.af.faction_blacklist.label: Faction Blacklist
settings.af.faction_blacklist.placeholde: One faction editor ID per line
settings.af.faction_whitelist.desc: List of factions to include (one per line). Only used when Filter Mode is 'WhitelistOnly' or to allow non-speech-capable actors.
settings.af.faction_whitelist.label: Faction Whitelist
settings.af.faction_whitelist.placeholde: One faction editor ID per line
settings.af.filter_mode.desc: Choose between whitelist-only (only allow specified actors) or blacklist-exclusion (allow all except specified actors)
settings.af.filter_mode.label: Filter Mode
settings.af.gender_blacklist.desc: List of genders to exclude (one per line). Use 'Male' or 'Female'. Only used when Filter Mode is 'BlacklistExclusion'.
settings.af.gender_blacklist.label: Gender Blacklist
settings.af.gender_whitelist.desc: List of genders to include (one per line). Use 'Male' or 'Female'. Only used when Filter Mode is 'WhitelistOnly' or to allow non-speech-capable actors.
settings.af.gender_whitelist.label: Gender Whitelist
settings.af.race_blacklist.desc: List of races to exclude (one per line). Default excludes animal races like DogRace, WolfRace, etc.
settings.af.race_blacklist.label: Race Blacklist
settings.af.race_blacklist.placeholder: One race editor ID per line
settings.af.race_whitelist.desc: List of races to include (one per line). Only used when Filter Mode is 'WhitelistOnly' or to allow non-speech-capable actors.
settings.af.race_whitelist.label: Race Whitelist
settings.af.race_whitelist.placeholder: One race editor ID per line
settings.af.speech_capable.desc: If enabled, only actors capable of speech will be processed
settings.af.speech_capable.label: Allow Only Speech-Capable Actors
settings.af.summoned_reanimated.desc: If enabled, summoned and reanimated actors will always be allowed regardless of other filter settings
settings.af.summoned_reanimated.label: Allow Summoned or Reanimated
settings.agents.default_variant.desc: Default LLM configuration variant for agent execution
settings.agents.default_variant.label: Default LLM Variant
settings.agents.enable.desc: Enable or disable the user agent system
settings.agents.enable.label: Enable Agents
Enable verbose logging for agent operations (may impact performance)
settings.agents.enable_mcp_tools.desc: Allow agents to access MCP tools for querying game data
settings.agents.enable_mcp_tools.label: Enable MCP Tools
settings.agents.execution_timeout.desc: Maximum time to wait for an agent execution to complete
settings.agents.execution_timeout.label: Execution Timeout
settings.agents.max_response_length.desc: Maximum character length for agent responses (0 = unlimited)
settings.character_overrides.charset.emp: No groups available. Create one above to get started.
settings.character_overrides.charset.no_: Select a character to manage their group inheritance.
settings.character_overrides.charset.ord: Inheritance Order — drag to reorder, top wins

settings.character_overrides.delete_all_: Delete every override for this target. The override file is removed from disk.

Base config has no rotation defined.
Copies the base rotation here so you can tweak individual slots without rebuilding from scratch.
settings.character_overrides.empty_group: No groups yet. Create one above.
settings.character_overrides.empty_overr: No character overrides yet. Create one from a nearby character.
settings.character_overrides.factions.hi: Actor-specific overrides → Faction group overrides → Explicit group inheritance → Base config
settings.character_overrides.factions.in: Map faction editor IDs to override groups. When an actor belongs to a mapped faction, they automatically inherit settings from that group. Higher priority factions are checked first when an actor belongs to multiple mapped factions.
settings.character_overrides.factions.pr: Higher priority = checked first when actor belongs to multiple factions.
settings.character_overrides.factions.to: A mapping for this faction already exists
settings.character_overrides.no_config: Select a configuration on the left to edit its overrides.
settings.character_overrides.no_overrida: This configuration has no overridable fields.

settings.convo.awareness_radius.desc: Core awareness radius in game units. Controls which NPCs can perceive events, overhear dialogue, be selected for actions, and receive event notifications. This is the active radius - toggle with whisper hotkey to switch between Normal and Whisper distances.
settings.convo.awareness_radius.label: Awareness Radius
settings.convo.bg_dialogue.desc: Maximum distance to detect background dialogue between NPCs (in game units)
settings.convo.bg_dialogue.label: Distance to Detect Background Dialogue
settings.convo.check_los.desc: Enable line-of-sight checking for event perception
settings.convo.check_los.label: Check Line of Sight
settings.convo.decisions_mood_confidence: Below this confidence the decision model's mood verdict is discarded and the NPC keeps its previous mood. Off disables the gate.
settings.convo.decisions_recent_events.d: How many recent events the decision model sees for mood, speaker selection and who you are addressing. Keeping this small keeps the request short and focused.
settings.convo.decisions_speaker_prob.de: Below this summed probability for the chosen speaker the selection is treated as silence. Off disables the gate.
settings.convo.decisions_use_for_mood.de: Ask the Decisions LLM variant for the NPC's mood as a typed choice with probabilities instead of a chat prompt. Uses the chat prompt when no decision provider is set up (the Decisions model under AI > Models) or the decision call fails.
settings.convo.decisions_use_for_mood.la: Evaluate Mood with the Decision Model
settings.convo.decisions_use_for_speaker: Pick who speaks next and to whom with the Decisions LLM variant, choosing from the legal speaker/target pairs. Silence is always one of the options, so the silence chance setting does not apply. Also picks who carries the scene on for Continue Narration and who speaks next in continuous mode. Uses the chat prompt when no decision provider is set up (the Decisions model under AI > Models) or the decision call fails.
Select Speakers with the Decision Model
Work out who you are speaking to with the Decisions LLM variant, choosing from the NPCs nearby. Someone always replies: without an answer, the NPC you are looking at, else the nearest. Uses the chat prompt when no decision provider is set up (the Decisions model under AI > Models) or the decision call fails.
Find Who You Are Addressing with the Decision Model
settings.convo.dialogue_package_duration: How long NPCs keep their dialogue package after finishing speaking. Higher = NPC stays focused on conversation partner longer.
settings.convo.dialogue_transform.desc: Allow transformation of dialogue content using AI models for enhanced conversation
settings.convo.dialogue_transform.label: Enable Dialogue Transformation
settings.convo.eligibility_timeout.desc: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for action eligibility checks to complete before building the dialogue prompt. Higher values ensure more accurate action availability but may increase latency. Only applies when 'Embed Actions in Dialogue' is enabled.
settings.convo.eligibility_timeout.label: Action Eligibility Check Timeout
settings.convo.embed_actions.desc: When enabled, action selection is embedded directly in the dialogue response prompt instead of using a separate action evaluation call. This can reduce latency but uses more tokens per request. When disabled, a separate LLM call evaluates actions after dialogue is generated.
settings.convo.embed_actions.label: Embed Actions in Dialogue
settings.convo.event_history_count.desc: The number of events shown in the context for dialogue generation.
settings.convo.event_history_count.label: Event History Count - Dialogue
settings.convo.interrupt_voice.desc: Interrupt all ongoing NPC dialogue when the player starts a voice input
settings.convo.interrupt_voice.label: Interrupt Dialogue On Voice Start
settings.convo.max_recent_speech.desc: Maximum number of speech lines allowed within the time window
settings.convo.max_recent_speech.label: Max Recent Speech Count
settings.convo.nearby_multiplier.desc: Multiplier applied to awareness radius when building the 'nearby NPCs' context for dialogue. Higher values let NPCs be aware of characters further away during conversations. Set to 2.0 to include NPCs at twice the normal awareness distance.
settings.convo.nearby_multiplier.label: Nearby NPC Context Multiplier
settings.convo.normal_awareness.desc: Default awareness radius used when whisper mode is off. NPCs within this range can perceive events, respond to dialogue, and be targeted by actions.
settings.convo.normal_awareness.label: Normal Awareness Radius
settings.convo.package_flags.desc: Default flags for AI behavior packages (bitmask for package behavior)
settings.convo.package_flags.label: Default Package Flags
settings.convo.package_priority.desc: Default priority level for AI behavior packages (0-100, higher = more priority)
settings.convo.package_priority.label: Default Package Priority
settings.convo.perceive_own.desc: Allow actors to perceive and react to their own dialogue
settings.convo.perceive_own.label: Allow Actors to Perceive Own Dialogue
Multiplier applied to awareness range when resolving a pinned target or @mention, so you can address a specific NPC from further than the normal awareness distance.
settings.convo.post_interaction.desc: Cooldown period after player finishes menu/dialogue before NPCs can speak
settings.convo.post_interaction.label: Post Player Interaction Cooldown (Seconds)
settings.convo.recent_speech_window.desc: Time window in seconds to check for speech density to prevent spam
settings.convo.speaker_silence_chance.de: Chance (0–100%) that the speaker selector is given the option to choose silence. Lower values produce a chattier world; higher values keep conversations terser. Not used when the decision model selects speakers: it can always choose silence.
settings.convo.speaker_strictness.desc: How readily NPCs speak up unprompted when the decision model picks the speaker. Chatty: companions react to whatever happens around you, and a loose fit with an NPC's "interjects when" bio text is enough. Balanced: companions need a fit with their bio or something that happens to you; everyone else speaks on a topical fit. Strict: anyone not addressed needs a specific match with their bio text, and silence is the default.
settings.convo.speaker_strictness.label: Speaker Selector Strictness
settings.convo.speaker_tag_companion.des: Tag candidate NPCs who are the player's follower and add companion-aware guidance to the selector prompt.
settings.convo.speaker_tag_engaged.desc: Tag candidate NPCs currently running the SkyrimNet follow package — they get a lower threshold to speak.
settings.convo.speaker_tag_engaged.label: Tag Engaged Followers as [ENGAGED]
settings.convo.speaker_tag_in_scene.desc: Tag candidate NPCs currently in a SexLab or OStim scene and strongly deprioritize them as speakers.
settings.convo.talk_to_player_package.de: Apply special behavior packages when NPCs talk to the player
settings.convo.talk_to_player_package.la: Should Apply Talk To Player Package
settings.convo.whisper_awareness.desc: Reduced awareness radius when whisper mode is on. Use for private conversations - only NPCs very close by will perceive what's happening.
settings.convo.whisper_awareness.label: Whisper Awareness Radius
settings.custom_themes.categories_hint: One shared palette for badges and labels across the dashboard.
settings.custom_themes.copy_confirm: Replace this theme's colors with the "{{preset}}" preset? Your current edits to this theme will be overwritten.
settings.custom_themes.title: Custom Themes
settings.dact.blacklist.label: Blacklist
settings.dact.categories.desc: Turn whole categories of fireable dialogue on or off.
settings.dact.enabled.desc: Master switch for the whole system. When off, the AI is never offered a vanilla dialogue line to trigger, and SkyrimNet stops reading NPCs' available dialogue before each reply. Turn it off if NPCs stop answering.
settings.dact.enabled.label: Enable Dialogue Actions
settings.dact.filter_mode.desc: Blacklist-exclusion exposes everything in enabled categories except listed entries (default). Whitelist-only exposes enabled categories plus any listed entries — the category toggles seed the whitelist, and the list adds specific lines on top (an enabled category needs no list entry; a line in a disabled category can be added by listing it).
settings.dact.filter_mode.label: Filter Mode
settings.dact.instructions.description: Per-line customization keyed by TIF script name: a custom instruction injected beside the line in the action prompt, a category override, or both.
settings.dact.instructions.empty_records: No instructions yet. Add one above, or use the Dialogue Actions button on a line in the Game Data Explorer.
settings.dact.instructions.revert_confir: Revert the instruction for "{{name}}" to the version {{plugin}} ships? Your copy will be removed.
Revert the instruction for "{{name}}" to the built-in version? Your copy will be removed.
settings.dact.intro: The filter mode and category toggles are your own settings. The whitelist, blacklist and line instructions come from the Content Library: SkyrimNet's built-in defaults, anything a plugin ships, and your edits on top. Each entry shows where it comes from.
settings.dact.list.desc: One entry per line, classified by format: a plugin (Skyrim.esm), a quest by bare EditorID (MS01) or, when it has none, plugin|FormKey (Skyrim.esm|1EA20), or a specific line by TIF script name (TIF__000D9B53). The active list depends on Filter Mode.
settings.dact.name_immutable: The TIF script name names the file and cannot be changed.
settings.dact.policy.desc: Saved in your settings; plugins cannot change these.
settings.dact.policy.heading: Your Policy
settings.dact.whitelist.label: Whitelist
settings.db.enabled.desc: Enable dynamic biography updates based on recent events
settings.db.enabled.label: Enable Dynamic Bios
settings.db.max_memories.desc: Maximum number of memories to consider for updates
settings.db.max_memories.label: Max Memories
settings.db.max_recent_events.desc: Maximum number of recent events to consider for updates
settings.db.max_recent_events.label: Max Recent Events
settings.db.min_importance_score.desc: Minimum importance score for memories to be included
settings.db.min_importance_score.label: Min Importance Score
settings.db.preserve_core_personality.de: Always preserve core personality traits even in dynamic updates
settings.db.updatable_blocks.desc: Which biography blocks can be dynamically updated
settings.db.updatable_blocks.label: Updatable Blocks
settings.devanalytics.flush_level.desc: Log level at which to automatically flush log buffers
settings.devanalytics.flush_level.label: Flush Level
settings.devanalytics.log_level.desc: Minimum level of log messages to display
settings.devanalytics.log_level.label: Log Level
settings.devanalytics.max_log_count.desc: Maximum number of log entries to keep in memory
settings.devanalytics.trace_retention.de: How long to keep completed execution traces in memory for viewing in the UI (in seconds). Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes).
settings.devanalytics.verbose_inja.desc: Emit detailed spans for Inja template rendering internals (set statements, for loops, includes). WARNING: Can cause significant performance overhead.
settings.devanalytics.verbose_inja.label: Verbose Inja Template Tracing
settings.devsystems.allow_multiple_trigg: Allow multiple triggers to fire for the same event (sorted by priority). When disabled, only the first matching trigger fires.
settings.devsystems.coalesce_window_ms.d: Time window in milliseconds for coalescing duplicate high-volume events (e.g., animation events). Set to 0 to disable coalescing.
settings.devsystems.decorator_warmup.des: Number of nearby actors to warm up Papyrus decorator cache for when player input is triggered. Followers are prioritized.
settings.devsystems.enable_event_filteri: Filter animation and mod events using whitelists for performance. Disable during development to see all events. WARNING: disabling this during regular play can cause performance issues.
settings.devsystems.enable_outbound_mod_: Fire SKSE ModCallbackEvents at key lifecycle points (diary, memory, speech, audio) for external mod integration.
settings.devsystems.event_queue_size.des: Maximum number of events to queue for trigger processing. Older events are dropped when queue is full.
